pr_body:

<!-- Thanks for submitting a pull request! Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request. -->

**Description:**

Per spec, the base of optional chain can only be either:
1. an member expression
2. an call expression which callee could only be an normal expression, not an super or import

**BREAKING CHANGE:**

AST definition changed

**Related issue (if exists):**
Would closes #3644 and closes #3610

issue_context.title: Wrongly transform private field access in optional call
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Would transpile into
```js
(ref = (_obj = _classPrivateFieldGet(this, _fieldFunc)).call) === null || ref === void 0 ? void 0 : ref.call(_obj, this);
```
which access `_classPrivateFieldGet(this, _fieldFunc)).call` and throws

### Input code

```typescript
class A {
    #fieldFunc;
    x = 1;
    test() {
        this.#fieldFunc?.();
    }
}
```


### Config

_No response_

### Playground link

https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.133&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0vOSSwuVnBUqOZSAALltMzUnBS30rxkazC%2FQsFWwRDCLEktLtHQhKoDC2RkFushNNjraWhCVNZy1QIAaypvMVYAAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WMSwrDMAxE76K1F00WpeQOPYRwleDiH5ICNcZ3r11cshtm3rwKb7GwVcjIQjySlKj4gQ3IBhTLLiuYjvVqRy%2FUDCjyQToQWW%2FLo88%2BJaEJGAguur0MmU0hM4lcE8bD%2F8nWXSG9zlFU0JLp57xDuxzz5%2BQ5QeWT2he%2FL5pQuAAAAA%3D%3D

### Expected behavior

check `_classPrivateFieldGet(this, _fieldFunc))` directly instead of `.call`
